def unit(v): v=np.array(v,float); return v/np.linalg.norm(v)
def rot_about(n, theta):
    n=unit(n); c,s=np.cos(theta),np.sin(theta)
    K=np.array([[0,-n[2],n[1]],[n[2],0,-n[0]],[-n[1],n[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3)*c + s*K + (1-c)*np.outer(n,n)
def ring6(P, Q, n, s=1.39):
    """hexagon vertices v0=P,v1=Q,... in plane with normal n"""
    n=unit(n); d=Q-P; s_act=np.linalg.norm(d)
    m=unit(np.cross(n,d)); c=(P+Q)/2 + m*(s*np.sqrt(3)/2)
    v0=P-c; v1=Q-c
